tests.expected: POST /reader/analyze with novelId of 257 chars → HTTP 413, body.error contains 'novelId exceeds maximum length'

tests.name: rsAnalyze rejects oversized text (>100k chars) with 413
tests.expected: POST /reader/analyze with text of 100001 chars → HTTP 413, body.error contains 'text exceeds maximum length'

tests.name: rsCreateCustomPersona rejects oversized name (>200 chars) with 413
tests.expected: POST /reader/personas/custom with name of 201 chars → HTTP 413, body.error contains 'name exceeds maximum length'

tests.name: rsCreateCustomPersona rejects NaN weight with 400
tests.expected: POST /reader/personas/custom with plotWeight=NaN → HTTP 400, body.error contains 'finite number'

tests.name: rsCreateCustomPersona rejects Infinity weight with 400
tests.expected: POST /reader/personas/custom with characterWeight=Infinity → HTTP 400, body.error contains 'finite number'

tests.name: rsCreateCustomPersona rejects out-of-range weight with 400
tests.expected: POST /reader/personas/custom with styleWeight=1.5 → HTTP 400, body.error contains 'between 0 and 1'

tests.name: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot throws on path traversal
tests.expected: Setting NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE='../etc/passwd' → safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() throws 'path traversal detected'

tests.name: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot tolerates Windows case mismatch
tests.expected: On Windows, setting NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE to a path differing only in case from cwd → no throw, returns resolved path

tests.name: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot allows outside path with ALLOW_OUTSIDE=true
tests.expected: Setting NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE='C:/outside' + NIKO_WORKSPACE_ALLOW_OUTSIDE='true' → returns resolved outside path

tests.name: validateStringLength returns null for valid strings
tests.expected: validateStringLength('hello', 10, 'test') returns null — no error

tests.name: validateWeight returns null for valid weights in [0,1]
tests.expected: validateWeight(0.5, 0, 1, 'weight') returns null — no error

tests.name: Chat endpoint rejects oversized message with 413
tests.expected: POST /chat with message > MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS → HTTP 413, body.error contains 'exceeds maximum length'

tests.name: All Reader endpoints still return 200 for valid short inputs
tests.expected: rsAnalyze/rsGetPersonas/rsCreateCustomPersona/rsGetOverlay with valid short inputs → HTTP 200/201

tests.name: No TypeScript compilation errors from security hardening changes
tests.expected: npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0 — zero TypeScript errors across all modified files

tests.name: No test regressions from security hardening changes
tests.expected: npx vitest run shows 5895+ passed tests, zero new failures (7 pre-existing gateway failures are known)

tests.expected: grep -r NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE in mcp/endpoints/ mcp/services/ reader/mcp/ services/ source files (excluding tests + input-validation.ts) returns 0 matches
